review_evidence: README says LLMLean integrates language models with Lean for tactic suggestions, proof completion and iterative refinement via external model APIs.
The 16 Lean files are predominantly API/configuration/prompt generation, tactic elaboration and proof-attempt checking; proposition declarations occur only in two LLMleanTest example files.
Those examples are standard set/function/Nat goals used to exercise generated tactics, not an independent mathematical development or a proof of correctness of the LLMLean system.

source_action.content_invariant: All 16 Lean files were scanned. The main LLMlean/ tree consists of API clients, configuration, prompt construction, tactic elaboration and iterative-refinement code, with no theorem/lemma declarations; proposition examples are confined to two test files and serve tactic-generation tests.
evidence: README identifies LLMLean as an integration for LLM tactic suggestions and proof completion.
Main modules implement OpenAI/Anthropic/Ollama request handling, prompts and Lean tactic/checking infrastructure.
Only LLMleanTest example files contain propositions, consisting of ordinary tactic benchmark goals.
source_action.rationale: LLMLean is proof-assistant tooling that calls external LLMs to suggest tactics/proofs; its proposition content is a test corpus for the tool rather than an independently addressable formalization source.

summary: Reviewed LLMLean and retire it as LLM-backed tactic/proof-completion tooling whose theorem examples are test fixtures.
